Episode 227. New Enemy, Enemy's Enemy (5)
As Jo excitedly ran off to prepare the Myeongin, Berakte chuckled.
"He must have wanted to kill that dimwit at least a thousand times by now. Boss, if the completed Myeongin performs worse than expected this time, too, don't stop me from killing him."
[There will be no such thing, Berakte. I have already checked the performance myself. Jo is still a person who needs to continue working for our great cause.]
"Right, right, Berakte. Stop picking on Jo. He was on your side when the demons were bad-mouthing you. He gave me a new arm like this, along with Bubare."
Badrei lifted his left arm. His left arm, which he had lost to Rakiman Hog, the Enemy Clan's former War King, had been replaced with a Myeongin arm.
"Or are you just being annoying because you have a hidden crush? Right? You actually like Jo. Berakte, you do have a cute side."
"You always pick the most worthless things to say, Badrei... When will you wake up and realize your responsibilities as an Enemy King?"
"Of course, I do realize that. That's why I have been training so hard since the day we escaped from Rakiman."
Badrei squinted his eyes recalling that day.

Even though the difference in pure strength was not that great and they could have overcome him together with Berakte, the two great warriors had to run away in disgrace because of the 'fear of the natural enemy'.
Ever since that day, Berakte and Badrei have been looking forward to the day they can get their revenge on the Enemy Clan. They trained relentlessly, fueled by their anger.
"It's a bit disappointing. I wanted to fight with the Enemy Clan bastards first, right, Berakte? I guess I'll have to make do with slashing the Infernal bastards for now."

[Don't worry, Badrei. The Enemy Clan is now at the mercy of the Imperial Court. They made a good impression at first, but they will inevitably become a lower power of the Imperial Court. Unless they can win the war against Zephyr with the blood they receive from the Imperial Court and occasionally from their raids.]
Naturally, Orgal was sure that the Enemy Clan could not win the war against Zephyr. The current Enemy Clan was just a remnant compared to its heyday.
"In that case, we need to deal with the Enemy Clan along with the Imperial Court."

[We might be able to eliminate them without lifting a finger. Once Zephyr pushes the Enemy Clan into a corner, the Imperial Court will take their technology and power and begin to expand their territory in earnest. Of course, Zephyr will have to wipe them out, and the Vamel Alliance will do the same. The Imperial Court has crossed the line. The moment Jin Lunadel finds out about Temar, they will become Lunadel's top priority for elimination.]
Orgal decided not to share information about the mine created in Temar, intending to use it strategically when the time comes.
"If that happens, it will be bitter for me and Berakt. I would love to tear those guys apart with our own hands."
[There will be an opportunity for you and Berakt to repay your humiliation, no matter how the situation evolves.]
"That's a relief."
Orgal thought about the Red Plutonian for a moment.

'The reason why the Royal family is controlling the Red Plutonian isn't just because of the blood supply. There's likely a bigger reason. For example, they might know something about the whereabouts of the Red Plutonian's war god... And when the Red Plutonian reach their limit, they could be planning to find the war god and turn him into their puppet.'
The Red Plutonian war god.
His memory about it was still faint to Orgal. However, it was clear that he was one of the strongest in his era along with the Blue Plutonian's war god.
If he had been there, the Jeokma War would have been very different. The royal family wouldn't have been able to control the Red Plutonian as they do now.

'You never know, the war god might wake up without the help of the royal family and become the savior of the Red Plutonian remnants. So, it's better not to confront them directly. It would be best to cautiously interfere when a power finishes off the Red Plutonian and only take what is needed.'
The same goes for the Royal family. Orgal was hoping that other powers would take care of the Royal family.
When the time comes, like the Royal family is doing to the Red Plutonian now, Kinzelo plans to swallow and control the weakened Royal family.

'We have to make them spit out all the information they know about Lokia and the Sun God. Especially Lokia, their intelligence about that bug was surprising. The world of Lokia, who knew it existed... I can use this information when trading with Jin Runcandel.'
He had heard about 'Lokia's world' from Manopf in Pierol.
Unfortunately, Orgal didn't know that Jin already recognized Lokia's world.
Orgal looked at his executives.
[As soon as Jo finishes preparing, we'll depart. Everyone take your positions.]
Underground, Red Plutonian's 4th city, Usurok.
Rakiman Hog, Bekios Kam, Gaila Tun, Bakarun Yung.

All the great warriors, excluding the owner of the 5th city, Drekhon, who was killed by Jin, gathered in one place. 'The tribeless', first-class warrior Shimat, was reporting the war situation to them.
"......That's all, fellow great warriors."
"Ha, the situation is worse than I thought. Not only Drakka, but even our brethren who went to attack the Milcun Kingdom have been annihilated?"
"We don't have enough blood to properly operate the airborne fortress, so we can't properly keep the Elona Zipfel in check either. Damn it, at least we haven't lost our warships, that's a relief."
This was spoken by Gaila and Bekios.

Among the grand fighting kings, only those two were in a 'fit to answer properly' state. Rakiman was still recovering from the injuries he had sustained in the last encounter with Octavia, and Baccarun, the strongest grand fighting king, was barely conscious due to lack of blood. A low metallic sound was made each time Rakiman and Baccarun breathed.
"Every time we invade, we waste the blood we had instead of gaining more. This kind of battle is being repeated."

"It's probably because the blood supplied by the Royal Family and the corpses of the Blue Plutonian tribe are steadily decreasing. If they could give us the same amount of Blue Plutonian tribe corpses as the last time we operated the airborne fortress, we could turn the tables... especially since Zipfel has sent his forces to Grosh Fortress."
"I have the same thoughts as Gaila. Shimat, you should go and make a request to the Vermont. If we continue like this, both we and the Royal Family are going to crumble."
Hearing the answers of the grand fighting kings, Shimat felt an uncontrollable anger. It was like looking at incompetent and foolish subordinates.

It should be Gaila and Bekios leading the Red Plutonian tribe now that Baccarun is not in a normal state. And as Shimat saw, they were lacking in every aspect except for combat power, which was stronger than his.
It had always been this way. Shimat had high expectations for the awakening of the grand fighting kings, but this was the reality.
"Grand fighting king brethren, since when have we, the Red Plutonian tribe, been unable to live without relying on lower races?"
"What?"
"Have you become so accustomed to receiving food like a domesticated beast?"
"Shimat, you seem to be making a mistake."

"The mistake is not mine, it's you, grand fighting king brethren! Don't you still understand? The Royal Family is taming us. They are deliberately controlling various supports to create a situation where we have no choice but to submit to them. Just like now!"
"It seems you have forgotten your place for a moment, brother. Let me remind you....."
Just as Bekios was about to strike Shimat with his fist, Baccarun raised his trembling hand to stop him.
"Stop...and...listen..."
Even if he was weak right now, Baccarun was the highest in rank among the grand fighting kings. Bekios showed a displeased expression but immediately stopped his action.
"Continue...your speech...Brother Shimat."
".....Thank you, Brother Baccarun."
Shimat looked squarely into the eyes of the grand fighting kings.

"As I just mentioned, we have been in a state where we can do nothing without the royal family for some time. It was because our situation was so desperate at the beginning that we had no choice but to accept unconditional support, and also because a few of our kind, the Grand Dukes, made big mistakes."

He meant Rakiman and Drek. Especially, if Drek hadn't died recklessly attacking Joryong Castle, he would've been able to pressure the major powers with his vampiric abilities by now. Also, the supply of blood for our kind would have been incomparable to what it is now.
The Grand Dukes watched Shimat's ongoing irreverent behavior silently. Until Bakarun expressed his displeasure, no one could complain about Shimat.

"But the royal family isn't truly for our kind, the Red Plutonian clan, and in my opinion, their goal is to steal our technology and make their own weapons. That's why they trade with us when they need it, taking our technology with blood and buried Blue Clan members. They've been controlling us, making us weak and taming us, planning to swallow or dispose of us."
"…So, what do you want to do going forward? Shimat. As you say, we're already in a situation where it's difficult to do anything without the help of the royal family."

"The biggest reason we've reached this point is because we gained little from the war with the Zieple. Initially, the royal family provided abundant support, and we could obtain the blood of Zieple wizards thanks to the absence of Elona Zieple, but our losses have been growing."
"So, you want to end the war with Zieple?"

"Yes. However, it must not seem that way on the surface. That way, the royal family won't stop their support. We must continue pretending to fight Zieple as the royal family wants while we amass strength. At least until Bakarun can regain his power."
"Pretending to fight Zieple without the royal family knowing, is that possible?"

"It is possible. After Elona Zieple appeared, the royal family hasn't been able to verify each of our battles with Zieple. They must be afraid of her. Or, they may want to hide themselves as much as possible in fear of the completion of the 'Mashin Stone'."
"Hmm, let's skip that then. What's next?"
Shimat took a moment to catch his breath.
It was a moment to make a decision that would affect the fate of the Red Plutonian clan.

"…We're going to strike at the royal family. They think they know everything about us because they've been using us, but they don't. All this time, they've been threatening us, promising to tell us the whereabouts of the Incarnate, but I think they don't know where the Incarnate is. Or, even if they know, they can't use the Incarnate at will. If they could have used the Incarnate as they wanted, they would've done it already."
"Uh, um... I kind of understand what you mean. But isn't it too risky? We might lose the Incarnate forever, and even the support we've been receiving from the royal family..."

"If we don't make this bold choice now, our Red Plutonian clan will inevitably become the dogs of the royal family. If the Grand Dukes reject my opinion, I will choose the path for the Red Plutonian clan alone."
There was a heavy silence for a while. Naturally, the eyes of the Grand Dukes and Shimat were fixed on Bakarun.
"Shimat... I... agree with your... opinion."
Finally, Bakarun nodded heavily and said so.
